dict.string: Project Chimera Universal Config - Skyscope Sentinel AI, Director. Master Template v1.1
ACPI Section: Base stability for all modern systems. Curated by Skyscope AI (Model: Dr. Evelyn Reed Profile).
SSDT-PLUG-ALT.aml: Essential for native CPU Power Management. For Intel, consider CPU-specific PLUG. For AMD, specific PM SSDTs are needed.
SSDT-EC-USBX.aml: Fakes an Embedded Controller & handles USB Power. Essential for boot on most modern platforms.
SSDT-AWAC.aml: Disables legacy AWAC clock. Required for 300-series+ Intel boards. Can be disabled on older systems or AMD.
SSDT-RHUB.aml: Resets USB Root Hubs. Universal fix for post-sleep USB issues.
SSDT-HPET.aml: Resolves IRQ conflicts (HPET, RTC, TIMR). Universal stability enhancement.
SSDT-SBUS-MCHC.aml: Injects fake SMBus device. Improves sensor and motherboard compatibility.
SSDT-GPRW.aml: Fix for 'instant wake' from sleep. Enable this and the GPRW->XPRW patch if you have wake issues.
SSDT-DISABLE-IGPU.aml: Disables internal GPU. Use if dGPU is primary and iGPU is unused or causes issues.
Drop CpuPm: Remove OEM CPU Power Management table if using custom SSDT-PLUG.
Drop Cpu0Ist: Remove OEM CPU Idle State table if conflicting.
GPRW->XPRW: Complements SSDT-GPRW for instant wake fix. (Skyscope AI: Dr. Sharma Profile)
Booter Section: Foundational settings for UEFI boot. Managed by Skyscope AI (Model: Kenji Tanaka Profile).
DeviceProperties: Hardware Spoofing & Injection Profiles. Enable and configure relevant entries. (Skyscope AI: Chloe Davis, GPU Lead Profile)
PROFILE: Intel UHD 630 (Coffee/Comet Lake). TOOL_GENERATED: Enable for iGPU-only systems or iGPU+dGPU. Set PciRoot path.
PROFILE: AMD Navi 2X (e.g., RX 6800 XT). TOOL_GENERATED: Enable for AMD dGPU systems. Set PciRoot path. May need 'agdpmod=pikera' in boot-args.

PROFILE: NVIDIA dGPU Spoof (e.g., GTX 970 as RX 560X). TOOL_GENERATED: Enable for unsupported NVIDIA dGPUs. Set PciRoot, device-id, model. Requires '-wegnoegpu' and 'agdpmod=pikera' (sometimes) in boot-args.
PROFILE: Onboard Audio. TOOL_GENERATED: Determine PciRoot for Audio (e.g., PciRoot(0x0)/Pci(0x1F,0x3)). Set correct layout-id.
PROFILE: Intel Ethernet. TOOL_GENERATED: Set PciRoot path. Ensure 'built-in' is set.
Use this section to explicitly remove properties from devices, e.g., conflicting NVIDIA properties if spoofing.
Kernel Section: Kexts are the drivers. Enable only what your hardware needs. (Skyscope AI: Maria Flores, Kext Integrator Profile)
Lilu: The core patching engine. ALWAYS ENABLED.
VirtualSMC: Emulates Apple's System Management Controller. ALWAYS ENABLED.
SMC Plugin: CPU temperature monitoring. Recommended.
SMC Plugin: Fan speed monitoring. Recommended if SuperIO chip present.
WhateverGreen: GPU patching (Intel, AMD, NVIDIA spoofing). ALWAYS ENABLED.
AppleALC: Audio patching for onboard audio. ALWAYS ENABLED (if onboard audio used).
LAN KEXT: For Intel I210-I219, I225, I226 NICs. Enable if you have one.
LAN KEXT: For Realtek 2.5Gb RTL8125 NICs. Enable if you have one.
LAN KEXT: For Realtek Gigabit RTL8111/8168 NICs. Enable if you have one.
WIFI KEXT: For Intel WiFi cards. Choose this OR AirportBrcmFixup. DO NOT ENABLE BOTH.
BT KEXT: For Intel Bluetooth. Enable if using Intel WiFi/BT.
BT KEXT: Intel Bluetooth Patcher (works with Firmware uploader). Enable if using Intel WiFi/BT.
BT KEXT: Bluetooth Hotfix for Monterey+. Load after BT firmware/patcher kexts.
USB Port Injection (Legacy, prefer USBMap.kext or SSDT-UIAC/SSDT-RHUB for port mapping)
NVMeFix: Patches for non-Apple NVMe SSDs for power management and compatibility.
RestrictEvents: Blocks unwanted processes/notifications, improves CPU name visibility in About This Mac.
Miscellaneous settings for bootloader behavior. (Skyscope AI: Samuel 'Logs' Jones, Debug Chief Profile)
NVRAM: Boot arguments and system variables. (Skyscope AI: Dr. Anya Sharma, Quirks Analyst Profile)
TOOL_GENERATED: Add alcid=X for audio, agdpmod=pikera for Navi/Big Navi GPUs, etc.
PlatformInfo: The identity of your Mac. Choose ONE SMBIOS. (Skyscope AI: Isabella Rossi, SMBIOS Guardian Profile)
TOOL_GENERATED: RECOMMENDATIONS based on CPU: iMac20,1/2 (Comet Lake), MacPro7,1 (Xeon/HEDT), Macmini8,1 (Coffee Lake), iMacPro1,1 (Skylake-X)
UEFI drivers and quirks. (Skyscope AI: Kenji Tanaka Profile)
